verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DLSS and RTX 5070 family pages document the features for RTX 50 Series parts, which include this card: AI Super Resolution upscaling, Frame Generation, and Multi Frame Generation (4X mode on 50 Series, up to five generated frames per rendered frame, dynamic multiplier). Broad game support comes from the NVIDIA app, which can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features. A TechPowerUp review independently notes using DLSS on this card to reach 4K. Missing for 10: hands-on benchmarks of frame generation on the 5070 Ti specifically, and an independently verified count of supported games.
